sourceName: Shibuya City — household waste separation guide

streams.name: Plastic packaging
streams.localName: プラスチック製容器包装

rules.instruction: Take the cap and the label off, rinse it, then crush it flat.
rules.caution: The cap and label are a different stream — only the bottle itself counts as PET.

rules.instruction: Rinse it and put it out with plastic packaging, on the marked collection day.
rules.caution: Only packaging marked with the プラ symbol belongs here.
Plastic that is not container packaging is burned here, not recycled.

rules.instruction: Rinse it and put it out with cans and bottles. Do not crush it.
Metal that is not a drinks can goes with non-burnable waste.
Rinse it, take the cap off, and put it out with cans and bottles.
Non-burnable waste. Wrap anything broken in paper and mark it.
rules.caution: Only bottles and jars count as a resource — other glass does not.

rules.instruction: Rinse it, cut it open, dry it flat, then put it out with paper.
rules.caution: Cartons with a foil lining are burnable, not paper.

rules.instruction: Flatten it and tie it with string for paper collection.
rules.caution: Anything greasy, waxed or food-soiled is burnable instead.
There is no household composting collection here, so compostable plastic is simply burned.

rules.instruction: Small wooden and cork items are burnable.
